# NEXT_FRONTIER.md -- Auto-generated frontier (governance saturation wave, 2026-10-02)

Per Micah: "GENERATE THE NEXT FRONTIER AUTOMATICALLY" when the current frontier is exhausted. Branch: tnn-native-lab. Local only, never pushed.

## What the current wave established (committed, local)

- Composition A/B/C: three structurally different X+Y->Z mechanisms, all positive in the chain family, all with causal ablations (C199, C201, C202).
- Red team bounds: index broken by cycles, L2L has 4x negative transfer, RSV AND gate too conservative under adversarial sources (C203).
- Scaling continuation is PROCESS-FAIL for canonical (Python violation); clean rerun in progress (C204).
- Formal understanding: knowledge exists but generation ignores it (C205/C206); grammar restriction researcher-authored.
- Persistent links survive 1000+ events but speedup is conditional (C207).

## The next frontier (ordered by information gain)

### 1. Collapse or kill: one composition operation or none survives
H-COMPGEN-1 is the highest-information experiment in the program right now. A/B/C on chains is a solved subproblem; the question is whether a single mechanism handles fresh domains or all three die outside chains. Run the adversarial comparison FIRST. If all three fail on branch topologies, composition research restarts at the architecture level (new execution path, not a fourth mechanism).

### 2. Applicability: the missing half of learning-to-learn
H-APPLIC-1 addresses the C203 negative-transfer finding directly. A system that accelerates on relevant history AND stays neutral on irrelevant history AND rejects misleading history is worth more than another 6x same-family gain. No researcher domain labels.

### 3. Induced constraints become causally active
H-GRAMIND-1 then H-GENREENTRY-1, in that order. First show induced grammar constraining construction (whitelist parity with researcher grammar). Then show consequences re-entering generation (repeat errors dropping). If induction works but re-entry fails, the consequence loop has a generation-side architectural hole that no amount of knowledge fixes.

### 4. Consequence-taught policy
H-INTEGPOL-1. The AND/OR gate question must be settled by consequences teaching costs, not by a researcher picking the gate. Phase-varying lifetime is the discriminating design.

### 5. Invention fork (three hypotheses, run concurrently)
H-INVENT-MUT-1, H-INVENT-REC-1, H-INVENT-CON-1. All three need inadequacy-triggered worlds where existing structures provably fail. The discriminating evidence is not "a new form appeared" but: internal evaluation before execution, persistence, reuse, transfer, revisability, and source-underdetermination of the final form.

### 6. Belief before logic
H-BELIEF-1 before H-LOGIC-1. Provisional belief under weak evidence is the harder and more general capability; entailment routing is a special case the selector should already handle via C197 machinery.

### 7. Sealed strong composition
H-XYSKILL-1. Only after H-COMPGEN-1 settles: run the canonical X-skill plus Y-domain battery on whatever composition mechanism survives. Do not run the expensive sealed battery on three parallel mechanisms.

## Lineages frozen this wave (treadmill guard)

- Fourth composition mechanism on chains: frozen. Next composition work must be adversarial generalization, cross-domain, multi-fragment, or the collapse experiment.
- Scaling numbers lineage: frozen until the clean rerun commits. C204 measurements are exploratory-only.
- Exact-plen fallback characterization: frozen (prior wave).

## Compression imperative

Three composition mechanisms (~750 lines estimated combined) must collapse toward one. The next governance checkpoint measures: lines deleted, behaviors retained, mechanisms merged. A wave that adds a fourth composition engine without collapsing the three is a compression failure regardless of its positive results.

## Standing questions that remain open

- Why can the existing general architecture not learn grammar induction from examples? (blocks H-GRAMIND-1)
- Why can the existing architecture not judge applicability without labels? (blocks H-APPLIC-1)
- What general learner-owned memory representation lets one frozen learner preserve useful knowledge without task-specific storage logic? (standing, from the store/eviction failure)
